$ qm "state" "broken" "fridge"
exit 1
--- stderr
qm: malformed work item file ROOT/work-items/broken.md
--- broken.md
no front matter at all

$ qm "note" "broken" "x"
exit 1
--- stderr
qm: malformed work item file ROOT/work-items/broken.md
--- broken.md
no front matter at all

$ qm "list"
exit 1
--- stderr
qm: malformed work item file ROOT/work-items/broken.md
--- broken.md
no front matter at all
